Notwithstanding any other provision of this code, design and installation documents for the installation of alternative automatic fire-extinguishing systems shall be filed with and reviewed by the Fire Department for compliance with this code, the New York City Fire Code and other applicable laws and regulations in accordance with Section 105 of the New York City Fire Code.
(Am. L.L. 2018/195, 12/1/2018, eff. 5/30/2019)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2018/195.
